---
title: Secure web applications
description: Call Addis AI through a server route without exposing credentials.
---

# Secure web applications

The browser sends user input to your authenticated server route. Your server validates the request, calls the Addis AI SDK, and returns a limited response.

```ts
// app/api/chat/route.ts
import AddisAI from "addisai";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

const addis = new AddisAI();

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const { prompt } = await request.json();
  if (typeof prompt !== "string" || prompt.length > 4_000) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid prompt" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const response = await addis.chat.completions.create({
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
  });
  return NextResponse.json({ text: response.choices[0].message.content });
}
```

Add your own authentication, CSRF protection where applicable, abuse controls, and tenant-level quotas. Never place `ADDIS_API_KEY` in public environment variables or client bundles.
